channel.title: Rugby's Roaming Wiki
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Rugby's Roaming Wiki

item.title: Rich's Monk (DungeonVice)
item.description: Rich’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: a monk fighting with Crane Style, Stunning Strike, and flurry of blows. Never named on mic in session 3.

item.title: Raven
item.description: Also heard as: Donovan, Johnny, Jonathan A human witch, roughly 50 years old and twice divorced, with a familiar zoog that prefers eating sentient beings.

item.title: Pat's Wizard
item.description: Pat’s main-arc character: a tiefling with a prehensile tail, a wood-mage wizard who later also casts spells described as sorcerous.

item.title: Pat's Wizard (DungeonVice)
item.description: Pat’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: a wizard.

item.title: Ozone
item.description: Also heard as: Ozan's character, Mr. Vajidkas Ozan’s bard-type character in the DungeonVice campaign, going by the disguised alias “Mr.

item.title: Ozan's Alchemist
item.description: Also heard as: Zendrick, Lobel, Nadi, Nadia, Woo, Wubu Tang An alchemist/investigator-type character played by Ozan — AC 22, mithril shirt, thieves’ tools, low Strength and high Dexterity.

item.title: Obadiah Jones
item.description: A Loxodon cleric, chaotic good, found frozen in ice by the party and freed mid-session; joins the party as a new PC played by Ryan, a new player this session.

item.title: Nutty's Healer (Arc I)
item.description: Also heard as: Nutty's character, the possessed healer Nutty’s Arc I character, an alchemist/healer whose body is unknowingly possessed by a demon for several sessions after Nutty touches a cursed soul gem — a secret even Nutty’s own player hadn’t fully known until it was revealed in-game.

item.title: Nutty's Arcane Combatant (DungeonVice)
item.description: Nutty’s character in the DungeonVice campaign: an arcane combatant wielding a bladed tail weapon (treated as a scimitar), casting Web and a touch-spell/weapon combo nicknamed “Washashaka” (also heard as “Walshashah”).
